description:
[Merchant] A placement's next airings, each in its rule's time zone so daylight-saving shifts are visible. Use it to check a rule does what was meant before relying on it.

**Endpoint:** GET /products/{productId}/placements/{placementId}/airings/next

placementId.description: The placement's ID: pl + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pl7e4rCToG

productId.description: The product's ID: pr + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pr7e4rCToG

useSandbox.description: Use the sandbox (the default) rather than production

name: payware_products_get_next_airings
